targets.rawSql:
SELECT
	timestamp                  AS timestamp,
	chlorine_unit_alarm__value AS chlorine_unit_alarm
FROM marpower__250000_tech_water
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'chlorine_unit_alarm' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END) AS chlorine_unit_alarm_tag
FROM public.marpower__io_metadata
WHERE mqtt_topic = 'marpower/250000-techwater'

SELECT
	timestamp                           AS timestamp,
	drain_vlv_y_01_pos_overboard__value AS drain_valve1_pos_overboard,
	drain_vlv_y_02_pos_overboard__value AS drain_valve2_pos_overboard
FROM marpower__250000_tech_water
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'drain_vlv_y01_pos_overboard' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' END) AS drain_valve1_pos_overboard_tag,
  MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'drain_vlv_y02_pos_overboard' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' END) AS drain_valve2_pos_overboard_tag
FROM marpower__io_metadata
WHERE mqtt_topic = 'marpower/250000-techwater'

SELECT
	timestamp                                  AS timestamp,
	valve_cold_air_fr_68_y_03_openclose__value AS valve_cold_air_cool_water_y03,
	valve_cold_air_fr_32_y_04_openclose__value AS valve_cold_air_cool_water_y04,
	valve_cold_air_fr_32_y_05_openclose__value AS valve_cold_air_cool_water_y05
FROM marpower__250000_tech_water
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'valve_cold_air_fr68_y03_openclose' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END) AS valve_cold_air_cool_water_y03_tag,
  MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'valve_cold_air_fr32_y04_openclose' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END) AS valve_cold_air_cool_water_y04_tag,
  MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'valve_cold_air_fr32_y05_openclose' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END) AS valve_cold_air_cool_water_y05_tag
FROM public.marpower__io_metadata
WHERE mqtt_topic = 'marpower/250000-techwater'
GROUP BY ts

SELECT
	timestamp AS time,
	chlorine_unit_alarm__value                 AS fresh_water_chlorine_unit_alarm,
	drain_vlv_y_01_pos_overboard__value        AS drain_valve1_pos_overboard,
	drain_vlv_y_02_pos_overboard__value        AS drain_valve2_pos_overboard,
	valve_cold_air_fr_68_y_03_openclose__value AS valve_cold_air_cool_water_y03_openclose,
	valve_cold_air_fr_32_y_04_openclose__value AS valve_cold_air_cool_water_y04_openclose,
	valve_cold_air_fr_32_y_05_openclose__value AS valve_cold_air_cool_water_y05_openclose
FROM public.marpower__250000_tech_water
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC;

SELECT
  timestamp                          AS timestamp,
  adiabatic_cool_b_03_flow__value    AS adiabatic_cool_b03,
  adiabatic_cool_b_07_flow__value    AS adiabatic_cool_b07,
  adiabatic_cool_b_08_flow__value    AS adiabatic_cool_b08,
  adiabatic_cool_b_09_flow__value    AS adiabatic_cool_b09,
  reel_for_deckwash_b_04_flow__value AS deckwash_reel_B04,
  reel_for_deckwash_b_05_flow__value AS deckwash_reel_B05,
  reel_for_deckwash_b_06_flow__value AS deckwash_reel_B06
FROM marpower__250000_tech_water
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp

SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'adiabatic_cool_b03_flow' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END)     AS adiabatic_cool_b03_tag,
  MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'adiabatic_cool_b07_flow' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END)     AS adiabatic_cool_b07_tag,
  MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'adiabatic_cool_b08_flow' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END)     AS adiabatic_cool_b08_tag,
  MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'adiabatic_cool_b09_flow' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END)     AS adiabatic_cool_b09_tag,
  MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'reel_for_deckwash_b04_flow' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END)  AS deckwash_reel_b04_tag,
  MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'reel_for_deckwash_b05_flow' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END)  AS deckwash_reel_b05_tag,
  MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'reel_for_deckwash_b06_flow' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END)  AS deckwash_reel_b06_tag
FROM public.marpower__io_metadata
WHERE mqtt_topic = 'marpower/250000-techwater'
LIMIT 1

SELECT
	timestamp                        AS timestamp,
	charcoal_filter_b_01_flow__value AS charcoal_filter_flow,
	charcoal_filter_b_02_temp__value AS charcoal_filter_temp,
	salinity_1__value                AS salinity1,
	salinity_2__value                AS salinity2,
	tank_1_level__value              AS tank1_level,
	tank_2_level__value              AS tank2_level

  MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'charcoal_filter_b02_temp' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END) AS charcoal_filter_temp_tag,
  MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'salinity1' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END)                AS salinity1_tag,
  MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = 'salinity2' THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END)                AS salinity2_tag,

FROM marpower__io_metadata
WHERE mqtt_topic = 'marpower/250000-techwater'

SELECT
	timestamp                       AS time,
	adiabatic_cool_b_03_flow__value AS adiab_cool_b03_flow,
	adiabatic_cool_b_07_flow__value AS adiab_cool_b07_flow,
	adiabatic_cool_b_08_flow__value AS adiab_cool_b08_flow,
	adiabatic_cool_b_09_flow__value AS adiab_cool_b09_flow

SELECT
  timestamp                        AS time,

SELECT
  timestamp         AS time,
	salinity_1__value AS salinity1,
	salinity_2__value AS salinity2
FROM marpower__250000_tech_water
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp;

SELECT
  timestamp           AS time,
